_comment: Repo-local caveman default, read by the caveman plugin's SessionStart hook
(src/hooks/caveman-config.js walks up from cwd looking for .caveman.json or
.caveman/config.json). Pinning it here means the repo starts sessions at the
intended intensity even on a machine whose user-level config says otherwise,
and it is visible in the repo rather than only in %APPDATA%.
Resolution order: CAVEMAN_DEFAULT_MODE env > this file > user config > 'full'.
Valid: off, lite, full, ultra, wenyan-lite, wenyan, wenyan-full, wenyan-ultra.
